extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism/safety summary from XML/PDF text and supplementary source-data tables.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: A24 damages S. aureus cell wall and membrane morphology and increases membrane permeability.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: A24 against Staphylococcus aureus CVCC 546 and MRSA ATCC 43300

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=Effects of A24 on bacterial morphology and membrane
source_locator.evidence_note: Mechanism section reports microscopy, membrane permeability, membrane potential, and K+ leakage assays.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct evidence supports membrane damage/permeabilization; exact image-derived structural quantification is not normalized beyond source text and source-data tables.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: A24 treatment is associated with increased intracellular ATP and ROS levels in S. aureus CVCC 546.

source_locator.evidence_note: Text and Fig. 5f/g source data report ATP and ROS changes after A24 exposure.

mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports metabolic-disorder association; downstream causal ordering is not expanded beyond the authors' assays.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: A24 inhibits early biofilm and reduces mature biofilm/persister bacterial burden in tested S. aureus strains.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: A24 against MRSA ATCC 43300 and Staphylococcus aureus CVCC 546 biofilms

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=Eradication of biofilms and persistent bacteria by A24
source_locator.evidence_note: Body text and Fig. 4 source data support antibiofilm and persister-killing outcomes.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Functional antibiofilm evidence is recorded separately from molecular mechanism evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: A24 showed low in vitro hemolysis/cytotoxicity and no gross in vivo toxicity signal in the local paper materials.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=Evaluation of A24 safety in vitro and in vivo
source_locator.evidence_note: Safety section, Fig. 6 source data, and in vivo safety text support low-toxicity context.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Safety context does not imply clinical safety; it records the local in vitro and mouse assays only.
